decisions.what: Keep vendor startup, linker and main stack reservation
decisions.why: Single bare-metal image; no independent task stacks or scheduler.

decisions.what: Use app_config.h as authoritative values and config.h as public aliases
decisions.why: Preserve configuration editor support and the PRD config.h contract without duplicate values.

decisions.what: Default demo profile; in-vehicle axis magnitudes 0.45 g
decisions.why: Demo uses mandatory 32 C and 75 percent; 0.45 g lies within the specified vehicle range.
One main-context owner serializes MPU6050 and OLED operations; bounded display work must preserve 100 Hz sampling.

decisions.what: Dashboard transport is ST-Link VCP USART2; logo is sources/craftiailogo.png
decisions.why: VPD1 framed CSV selected for local transport; supplied bitmap converted to flash page format. External dashboard ingestion remains unverified.

revisions.why: Bare-metal app_start is called directly by vendor main; resources remain main-context owned. Vendor linker reserves a minimum 1024-byte main stack, not a task stack.
